Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Dense fitted sections — BLAZING warm gold-flecked lacquer across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep red lacquer lines and scattered gold dust between the sections, with carved relief of vines and leaves across the surface of every section, mirror-gloss lacquered, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT lacquer — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.

Background: a cherry-blossom avenue in full bloom with a pale paved path strewn with petals, a waist-high wooden fence, a standard park bench and lamp posts, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
